deploy-bot: Promo to prod failed for v2026.03.20-rc8 — staging artifact integrity check failed (BadZipFile).
jonathan: staging smoke shows wheel import failing 'zipfile.BadZipFile'.
sre-elena: gs:// listing shows parts out of numeric order (part-0003, part-0001, part-0002). Compose used wildcard; concurrent uploads likely reordered parts.
maria: so the composed tar is corrupted. Options: pin prod to rc7, deterministic re-compose from parts, or full rebuild.
devex-ania: checked run artifacts: build_metadata.json exists with parts_order ["part-0001","part-0002","part-0003","part-0004"]. I can compose explicitly in that order and verify with unzip -t.
release-czar: change window 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC. Need quick decision.
jonathan: rebuild ~40m; compose+verify ~10m. Recommend pin and recompose.
sre-elena: +1 pin then test. Lower risk.
maria: +1.
deploy-bot: Action: PIN prod -> v2026.03.20-rc7 (manual override by @release-czar).
devex-ania: composing now with explicit order and running unzip -t; will report.
devex-ania: composed artifact passes unzip test and uploaded to staging copy.
jonathan: staging smoke (import + basic checks) passed.
release-czar: decision: pinned to rc7, recompose succeeded, file ticket and PR to emit deterministic manifest and composer helper. Add release-note: "Hotfix: artifact compose ordering; pinned to rc7; ARTIFACT-452."
sre-elena: created ARTIFACT-452 and assigned to devex-ania.
devex-ania: will PR manifest writer and composer helper.
maria: added placeholder to internal release notes and linked logs: https://internal.redwood/builds/5832/logs.
deploy-bot: Pin complete. Thread closed at 3412353600.
